configured_cognition_may_read: task instruction supplied to the agent
task metadata explicitly supplied to the agent
files and command outputs actually present in the built runtime workspace after task environment startup
configured_cognition_must_not_read_befor: tests/** or hidden verifier logic not present in the runtime workspace
build-only benchmark source or Docker build context removed before runtime
repository environment/** source merely because it was used to build the runtime

stage_order.benchmark: CursorBench 4.0 or matched direct behavioral equivalent

acceptable_signals: successful long-horizon completion where baseline fails
verifier-confirmed improvement traceable to configuration-prescribed actions

execution_completion_policy.requirement_traceability: Every validity/rejection requirement must cite authoritative instruction or runtime-visible specification evidence.
execution_completion_policy.acceptance_coverage: Every explicit acceptance criterion must have fresh passing evidence before terminal authorization.
execution_completion_policy.runtime_oracle: If correctness depends on a concrete runtime engine or protocol implementation, exercise that class of runtime before submission or fail closed.
execution_completion_policy.browser_rule: Browser/UI/web-security acceptance requires actual browser-backed execution; absence of a browser is a blocker and cannot be recorded as PASS.
execution_completion_policy.security_interaction_rule: Adversarial/security preflight must include parser/runtime round trips plus composition, batching, or interaction effects when artifacts can be combined by the consumer.
execution_completion_policy.terminal_authority: Use BRAIN_SESSION_TERMINAL_AUTHORIZATION_V1 with zero known relevant failures and all acceptance/verification entries PASS.
execution_completion_policy.spent_task_rule: After independent verifier exposure, the task is spent and cannot be repaired/replayed for promotion.
execution_completion_policy.artifact_dependency_closure: Every runtime dependency must be submitted, explicitly declared with a proven install path, or guaranteed by the task contract.
execution_completion_policy.clean_room_artifact_replay: Before terminal authorization, execute the final submitted artifacts in a minimal clean environment containing only declared closure plus task-guaranteed runtime.
execution_completion_policy.development_runtime_rule: Ambient files/packages/services present only in the development container cannot count as evidence of artifact portability.
execution_completion_policy.constraint_role_separation: Classify resource/numeric values as desired targets, hard upper/capacity bounds, or minimum validity/safety floors. Do not substitute one role for another.
execution_completion_policy.boundary_saturation_oracle: If a desired target is blocked by an upper bound, test the active boundary and require saturation at the maximum legal feasible value while preserving minimum floors.
execution_completion_policy.actual_state_coupling: Recompute downstream outputs and feasibility from the actual constrained value after clipping/saturation, not from the ideal target.
